tools.name: aegis_scan
tools.description: Call before editing files: returns the governance rules that apply to them, ranked by ledger fitness and clamped to the JIT token budget. Mandatory rules (gates, invariants) take at most two slots; the others are listed in omitted_mandatory. Gates and invariants are served from the reviewed base commit (rules_base); branch-local edits to them never bind and are listed in unreviewed_rules. stale_rules lists rules edited since the last aegis sync. If any rule file cannot be loaded the scan fails (status FAIL) and names it.

files.description: Workspace-relative file paths you are about to edit. When omitted or empty, defaults to modified files in the current git working tree and index.

view.description: Optional response projection: 'full' (default, complete payload), 'summary' (retains identity/type/status/fitness fields, caps lists at 10 items, and adds <list>_count), or 'ids' (projects each list to rule ID strings). Error responses are never projected.

relevant_rules.description: Active rules matching the target files, ranked by fitness within the JIT token budget (rule objects in 'full'/'summary' view, or rule ID strings in 'ids' view).

relevant_rules_count.description: Total count of relevant_rules before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

guidance.description: Rendered markdown guidance block ready for prompt injection (omitted when view='summary' or 'ids').

invariant_warnings.description: Mandatory gate and invariant rules triggered by the target files.

invariant_warnings_count.description: Total count of invariant_warnings before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

rules_staged.description: Count of rules staged in relevant_rules after budget clamping (omitted when view='ids').

rules_staged_count.description: Total count of rules_staged before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

omitted_mandatory.description: Mandatory gate or invariant rules that matched but exceeded the two-slot mandatory cap.

omitted_mandatory_count.description: Total count of omitted_mandatory before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

stale_rules.description: Rules edited on disk since the last 'aegis sync' derived-file regeneration.

stale_rules_count.description: Total count of stale_rules before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

unreviewed_rules.description: Gate or invariant rules added or modified since rules_base whose local changes do not bind.

unreviewed_rules_count.description: Total count of unreviewed_rules before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

unreviewed_total.description: Total count of unreviewed gate or invariant rules across the workspace.

rules_base.description: Reviewed git base anchor from which binding gate and invariant rules were loaded.

stats.description: Scan telemetry summary including matched counts and token budget usage (omitted in 'summary'/'ids' views).

warnings_count.description: Total count of warnings before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

user_layer.description: Read-only user-layer metadata ({path, rules}) when scanning outside a governed Aegis workspace.

status.description: Optional status indicator ('not_governed' when scanning the user layer outside an Aegis workspace, or 'FAIL' on error).

reason.description: Unbound workspace reason code when status='not_governed'.

rule_errors.description: Rule files that failed to parse when status='FAIL'.

tools.name: aegis_report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether the rules you were shown helped. The server ties the report to the tree it computes now: with an `aegis check --record` run of exactly that tree it credits the rules it showed you that match the change (your rules_used is not what is credited), and even then only CI on the landing commit makes it count; without one it records a single unwitnessed claim per session and tree that earns nothing. Reports per session are capped.

outcome.description: Verification result for the rules in this change: 'success'/'tp'/'pass' record a true positive ('tp'), 'failure'/'fp'/'fail' record a false positive ('fp'), and 'partial' records a neutral trigger ('trigger').

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied unique key (1-256 chars, scoped per host and session). Retrying with the same key and outcome is a no-op; reusing a key with a different outcome fails with status 'FAIL'.

rules_used.description: Non-empty list of existing rule IDs from aegis_scan. Validated against the workspace rule inventory; actual fitness credit is computed server-side from session scan exposure and git diff paths.

tests_passed.description: Optional boolean recording whether the project's test suite passed during verification.

rework_count.description: Optional non-negative integer count of edit-and-retest cycles before verification succeeded (default: 0).

notes.description: Optional free-text context describing how the rules helped or failed (max 4096 chars).

files.description: Optional workspace-relative file paths edited in this change. Records one 'edit' activity event per idempotency_key for scan-before-edit compliance (aegis status --compliance); does not affect rule credit.

view.description: Optional response projection: 'full' (default, complete payload), 'summary' (retains identity/type/status/fitness fields, caps lists at 10 items, and adds <list>_count), or 'ids' (projects each list to rule ID strings). Error responses are never projected.

status.description: Report disposition: 'recorded' (witnessed by a matching check record), 'claimed' (unwitnessed self-report), 'rate_limited' (session cap reached), or 'FAIL'.

witness.description: Attestation tier: 'aegis' when backed by an 'aegis check --record' run for the current tree, or 'self' for unwitnessed claims.

credited.description: Rule IDs credited in the outcome ledger (empty for unwitnessed 'claimed' or 'rate_limited' reports).

credited_count.description: Total count of credited rules before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

check.description: Check record ID that witnessed the report (present when status='recorded').

tree.description: Git tree hash computed for the workspace at report time.

recorded.description: False when status='rate_limited' or when an unwitnessed claim for the same session and tree was already recorded.

limit.description: Per-session report cap (200) returned when status='rate_limited'.

source.description: Command or tool name that produced the response ('aegis_report_outcome').

checked_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the report was processed.

tools.name: aegis_create_rule
tools.description: Turn a natural language concern into a prompt that drafts a governance rule. It writes nothing: save the drafted rule under .aegis/rules/ yourself.

description.description: Non-empty natural-language description of the engineering defect, anti-pattern, or invariant to codify into a rule.

rule_type.description: Optional target rule category ('invariant' or 'gate' for blocking checks; 'trap', 'boundary', 'persona', or 'contract' for advisory guidance). Determines the target subdirectory under .aegis/rules/.

domain.description: Optional domain hint injected into the drafting prompt (e.g., 'security', 'correctness', 'efficiency', 'style', 'governance').

prompt.description: Structured rule-generation prompt containing schema requirements and up to three workspace rule examples.

instruction.description: Step-by-step instruction telling the caller where under .aegis/rules/<type_dir>/<id>.md to save the drafted markdown.

status.description: Present with value 'FAIL' only when input validation fails.

tools.name: aegis_list_rules
tools.description: List the governance rules as {rules, stale_rules, ignored}: every rule with its type, hypothesis and ledger fitness (a file that cannot be loaded is listed with _error), the rules edited since the last aegis sync, and markdown under .aegis/rules that is not a rule.

rule_type.description: Optional filter restricting both 'rules' and 'stale_rules' to a single rule category ('invariant', 'trap', 'gate', 'boundary', 'persona', or 'contract'). Omit to list all categories.

view.description: Optional response projection: 'full' (default, complete payload), 'summary' (retains identity/type/status/fitness fields, caps lists at 10 items, and adds <list>_count), or 'ids' (projects each list to rule ID strings). Error responses are never projected.

rules.description: Workspace rule records with metadata and ledger fitness (or rule ID strings when view='ids').

rules_count.description: Total count of rules before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

stale_rules.description: Rules edited since the last 'aegis sync' derived-file regeneration.

stale_rules_count.description: Total count of stale_rules before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

ignored.description: Non-rule markdown files under .aegis/rules/ with path and reason.

ignored_count.description: Total count of ignored files before 'summary' view truncation (present when view='summary').

status.description: Present with value 'FAIL' only when the rules directory cannot be safely loaded.

tools.name: aegis_capture_insight
tools.description: Record a user correction as an unconfirmed suggestion in user scope. Agent suggestions never count toward proposals or debits and never appear in aegis_scan; a suggestion upgrades to W2 only when its quote matches a hook-captured prompt in the same session.

quote.description: Non-empty verbatim quote of the user's correction or preference (1-1024 chars; secrets are automatically redacted and stored text is capped at 300 chars).

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative file paths this correction applies to (sets psrc='explicit'). When omitted or empty, defaults to currently modified git worktree paths (psrc='dirty').

status.description: 'OK' when the insight row was appended, or 'FAIL' on validation/storage error.

level.description: Corroboration tier: 'suggestion' initially, or 'W2' when matched to a hook-captured user prompt in the same session.

text.description: Secret-redacted and length-capped (max 300 chars) correction quote stored in the ledger.

paths.description: Workspace-relative file paths associated with this insight.

psrc.description: Path provenance: 'explicit' when caller supplied paths, or 'dirty' when inferred from git status.
